UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private host account profile storing Google account PII isolated strictly to the owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the host.

email.description: Verified Google email address of the host.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the host profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the host profile was last updated.

Quiz.title: Quiz
Quiz.description: Quiz definition owned by an authenticated host, readable by anonymous participants when active or expired.

hostUid.description: Owner UID matching Firebase Auth uid.

qrToken.description: Rotatable host QR session token generated each time a host creates or refreshes a quiz QR code.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last quiz update.

expiresAt.description: Nullable Firestore Timestamp when an active quiz expires.

questions.description: Bounded list (1-100) of MCQ, Short Answer, and Paragraph question maps.

JoinCode.title: JoinCode
JoinCode.description: Direct O(1) lookup mapping a 6-character join code to a quizId without allowing collection listing.

hostUid.description: Owner UID matching the parent quiz.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of join code creation.

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Anonymous participant submission stored under a quiz subcollection, keyed by unguessable sessionToken.

hostUid.description: Denormalized parent quiz hostUid verified via get() on create for O(1) host list queries.

sessionToken.description: Unguessable local browser session token matching the submissionId.

submittedAt.description: Server timestamp when submission was recorded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest grading update.

answers.description: Map of questionId to participant answers.

grading.description: Map of questionId to grading outcome, pointsAwarded, and host feedback.

maxScore.description: Maximum possible points for the quiz.

reviewStatus.description: Review status visible to host and participant.

autoSubmitted.description: Whether the submission was triggered automatically on timer expiration.

/users/{userId}.description: Private host profile storing verified Google email PII accessible only to the owning user.

/quizzes/{quizId}.description: Host-owned quizzes with questions, join codes, and expiration timestamps.

/joinCodes/{joinCode}.description: Direct get-only mapping from 6-character join code to quizId.

/quizzes/{quizId}/submissions/{submissio.description: Anonymous participant submissions and host grading records under each quiz.
